requirements.text:
Use Case1: Validate Token Access/Refresh Token Lifecycle (Introspect, Refresh, Revoke)
Spec portal: BoostAPI Portal
User Story
As a QA Engineer, I want to validate the complete token lifecycle functionality so that access tokens and refresh tokens can be securely generated, introspected, refreshed, and revoked based on the authentication flow.
Use Case Name
Validate Access Token and Refresh Token Lifecycle
Objective
Verify that:
Access Token is generated successfully after OTP validation.
Refresh Token is generated successfully after OTP validation.
Access Token can be introspected using /token/introspect.
Refresh Token can generate a new Access Token using /token/refresh.
Refresh Token can be revoked using /token/revoke.
Revoked Refresh Token can no longer be used.
Preconditions
1. Create Profile
Create a new profile with either of the following roles:
VIEW-ONLY
ADMIN
Capture the profileId from the response.
Example:
JSON
{
"profileId": "f7464fd9-4c75-425e-bdcf-0af23c3914f0"
}
2. Generate OTP
Invoke Generate OTP API:
JSON
{
"email": "john.doe@example.com",
"profileId": "f7464fd9-4c75-425e-bdcf-0af23c3914f0",
"accountNumber": "554632004483"
}
Capture the deviceId from the response.
Example:
JSON
{
"deviceId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000"
}
3. Validate OTP
Invoke Validate OTP API:
JSON
{
"otp": "000000",
"deviceId": "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000",
"profileId": "f7464fd9-4c75-425e-bdcf-0af23c3914f0",
"accountNumber": "554632004483"
}
Capture:
JSON
{
"accessToken": "<ACCESS_TOKEN>",
"refreshToken": "<REFRESH_TOKEN>"
}
